mapper.insert: insert into CHB_AST_VAL_SUB (REGIST_SEQNO,ISSUE_PARTY_ID,ASSET_CODE,VAL_DATE,UNIT_VAL_NET,UNIT_VAL_TOTAL,REMARK, STATUS,SEND_STATUS,CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE,SUBMIT_DEADLINE, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME,STATUS_DATE ) SELECT F_GUID() REGIST_SEQNO, VAL.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as ISSUE_PARTY_ID, ifnull(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) as ASSET_CODE, VAL.VAL_DATE as VAL_DATE, VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET as UNIT_VAL_NET, VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as UNIT_VAL_TOTAL, VAL.REMARK as REMARK, '01' STATUS, '01' SEND_STATUS, #{chbSubmitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, #{submitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} SUBMIT_DEADLINE, VAL.ORG_CODE ORG_CODE, VAL.DEPT_CODE DEPT_CODE, 'system' CREATE_USER, NOW() CREATE_TIME, 'system' UPDATE_USER, NOW() UPDATE_TIME, #{statusDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} STATUS_DATE FROM CHB_AST_VAL VAL LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE = VAL.ASSET_CODE WHERE DATE_FORMAT(VAL.VAL_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and not exists (select 1 from CHB_AST_VAL_SUB SUB where SUB.VAL_DATE = VAL.VAL_DATE and SUB.ASSET_CODE = VAL.ASSET_CODE and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') ) and not exists (select 1 from CHB_AST_VAL VAL2 where VAL2.VAL_DATE = VAL.VAL_DATE-1 and VAL2.ASSET_CODE = VAL.ASSET_CODE and VAL2.UNIT_VAL_NET = VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET and VAL2.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL = VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL )

SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, VAL.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, SUB.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, VAL.VAL_DATE as valDate, VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET as unitValNet, VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as unitValTotal, VAL.REMARK as remark, '02' status/*修改状态*/ FROM CHB_AST_VAL_SUB sub left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ifnull(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) = SUB.ASSET_CODE left join CHB_AST_VAL val on val.VAL_DATE = sub.VAL_DATE and val.ASSET_CODE = ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE and val.status in ('M','E')
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=sub.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(sub.VAL_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03')
AND CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and SUB.STATUS in ('01','02') and (val.UNIT_VAL_NET <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_NET or val.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL) UNION ALL SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, VAL.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, SUB.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, VAL.VAL_DATE as valDate, VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET as unitValNet, VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as unitValTotal, VAL.REMARK as remark, '01' status/*新建状态*/ FROM CHB_AST_VAL_SUB sub left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ifnull(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) = SUB.ASSET_CODE left join CHB_AST_VAL val on val.VAL_DATE = sub.VAL_DATE and val.ASSET_CODE = ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE and val.status in ('M','E')
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=sub.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(sub.VAL_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and SUB.STATUS ='03'
and CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and( SUB.STATUS ='03' or (val.UNIT_VAL_NET <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_NET or val.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL)) union all SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, sub.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, SUB.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, sub.VAL_DATE as valDate, sub.UNIT_VAL_NET as unitValNet, sub.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as unitValTotal, sub.REMARK as remark, '03' status/*删除状态*/ FROM CHB_AST_VAL_SUB sub left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ifnull(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) = SUB.ASSET_CODE
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=sub.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(sub.VAL_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and SUB.STATUS <>'03'
AND CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and not exists( select 1 from CHB_AST_VAL val where DATE_FORMAT(val.VAL_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(sub.VAL_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') and val.ASSET_CODE = ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE and val.STATUS != 'D' )
